detail.longDescription: xyOps v1.1.16 is out today! - SSO alongside local login with supported SSO plugins - Optional maximum queue wait time to abort jobs that wait too long - User visibility scoped by category and server group access - New "See All Users" privilege - HTML sanitization fixes that preserve Markdown content Release notes: https:// github.com/pixlcore/xyops/rele ases/tag/v1.1.16 # xyOps # OpenSource # SelfHosted
